note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English; the original records the alate as Imago: Unknown, so no Alate section is given. OCR problems: the body length of the pseudoworker appears in the original as '4.6-7.0 nun', nun being a corruption of mm; the antennae appear as '13 + segmented', meaning more than 13 segments.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, dark brown to black anteriorly, pale yellow posteriorly; antennal segments pale at the base, darker apically; labrum dark brown; mandibles black; pronotum yellowish brown with darker margins; mesonotum and metanotum paler; abdomen yellow. Head and body sparsely pilose. Total length (including mandibles) about 7.8 mm. Head capsule much longer than wide, rectangular; head length (to mandible base) 2.60; maximum head width 1.50 mm, width/length index 0.57; sides nearly parallel, slightly narrowing anteriorly, posterior margin rounded; frons weakly inclined anteriorly; Y suture present, not prominent. Eyes white, small, elongate-oval, 0.15 mm long. Ocelli absent. Antennae more than 13-segmented; segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 shortest. Anteclypeus a narrow white band at the base of the labrum; postclypeus flat, not clearly delimited from the frons. Labrum tongue-shaped, much wider than long, anterior margin with 3—4 setae on each side. Mandibles long and stout, apex weakly incurved, length about half the head length (to mandible base) (left mandible length/head length index 0.43); left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum flat, club-shaped, long, broader anteriorly and weakly bilobed, narrowing posteriorly into a long and narrow waist; length 1.93, maximum width 0.60, minimum width 0.23 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, much wider than long, margins and disc with a few short hairs; width 1.37, length 0.93 mm; slightly narrower than the head, pronotum width/head width index 0.91; anterior margin deeply incurved with a median notch; posterior margin with a weak median emargination. Legs short, sparsely pilose; femora inflated, tibiae slender; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; the outer margin of the mid tibia bears a stout lateral spine a short distance above the apical spur; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval, moderately pilose; cerci short, 2-segmented, pilose, 0.09 mm long; styli single-segmented, with 2—3 hairs near the apex.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule milky white; pronotum paler; clypeus and labrum yellowish brown; mandibles pale brown, teeth black; antennae, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head sparsely pilose, the rest of the body moderately pilose. Total length 4.6—7.0 mm. Head subcircular, slightly wider than long; head width 1.30—1.36, head length (to mandible base) 1.23—1.33 mm. Eyes reduced, appearing as small circular white spots below the antennae. Ocelli absent. Antennae 14—15-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Labrum wider than long, width 0.47—0.52, length 0.28—0.35 mm, anterior margin rounded; anteclypeus narrow, postclypeus wider than long. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth sometimes bearing a tooth-like process; right mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth. Pronotum flat; width 1.23—1.33, length 0.74—0.80 mm; anterior margin weakly concave with a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, weakly notched in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
